headline: HYBE Posts Record KRW 1.5 Trillion Revenue on BTS Tour
summary: HYBE reported record Q3 2026 revenue of KRW 1.5 trillion, driven by strong performance from the BTS tour.
why: Entertainment conglomerates depend on major global tour schedules and intellectual property monetization to drive record top-line revenue growth and margin expansion.

impacts.why: Record quarterly revenue validates core business model scalability and live performance profitability.
